correctness.rationale: Using the established complete 2(d-1) facet presentation, the prefix deficits u_k satisfy u_k>=r sqrt(k(d-k)/d) and L u<= (2-sqrt(2) r)1. Dirichlet path Green inverse has strictly positive entries min(i,j)(d-max(i,j))/d. Its k=1 bound gives the claimed r. The parabolic u_k=(r/H)k(d-k) attains it, and its B_k distance is r sqrt(k(d-k)/(d-1)). Equality only at k=1,d-1; strict positivity of first Green row proves uniqueness. Antipodal monotone permutations force the unique circumball of radius sqrt(d(d^2-1)/12). Independent calculations for every d=2..80 confirmed contact ratios, constraints and boundary case; the proof handles unbounded d.
